hero.title: Simple Secure & Open
hero.subtitle: Open-source apps engineered with integrity. No ads, no tracking, and open-source forever.

about.title: ABOUT @OneDroid
about.description: OneDroid is an open-source initiative focused on building simple, secure, and privacy-friendly softwares.

sections.title: (01) WE VALUE
content: OneDroid is an open-source platform dedicated to building modern Android applications with a strong focus on transparency, privacy, and usability. We develop apps in the open so anyone can review the source code, understand how things work, and contribute to making them better. Openness and collaboration are fundamental to how we build software.

Privacy is another fundamental principle behind OneDroid. Our apps are designed to respect users by avoiding unnecessary tracking, intrusive ads, and hidden data collection. Instead, we focus on creating reliable tools that work exactly as intended while protecting users’ digital freedom.

OneDroid exists to deliver practical solutions that solve everyday problems without compromising trust or user experience. By keeping our projects open, free, and community-focused, we aim to build a sustainable ecosystem of Android apps that anyone can use, improve, and rely on.

sections.title: (02) Maintainer
content: OneDroid is initiated and actively maintained by Tawhid Monowar, who leads the engineering efforts and long-term development strategy of the organization. He designs, builds, and maintains the core applications while ensuring the projects remain open source, secure, and aligned with the mission.

jotter.title: Jotter - Notes app
jotter.tagline: A modern, not just another notes app. Focus on speed, simplicity, and privacy. Free, Beautiful and Yours.

specs.bio: Jotter is built for an offline-first experience with a beautiful, dynamic UI. Backup and restore your notes easily.

features.title: Rich Notes
features.description: Material You theming with dynamic colors. Multiple view modes (List, Grid) and Haptic feedback.

features.title: Secure
features.description: Lock individual notes with a PIN or pattern. Includes Trash & Archive to keep you organized.

features.title: Offline First
features.description: All data is stored locally using Room Database. No cloud sync, no tracking. Your data is yours.
